0022600191.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (5-4, 4-1 at home, 1-3 on the road, on a W1 streak) host the New York Knicks (4-4, on a W2 streak) in the Cavaliers' 10th game of the 2026-27 season, and the teams have not yet met this season. Cleveland is 2nd in the Central, 1.5 games back, and 6th in the East, while New York is 4th in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 7th in the East. Cavaliers Jaylon Tyson is out with an ankle sprain, Jarrett Allen (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Knicks Josh Hart is out with an ankle injury. Last season the Cavaliers lost 1-2 to New York in the regular season and 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 130-93 loss in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
